messages:
sara: Heads up — if you refresh the Dashboard > Project view quickly after switching orgs, I can see rows from the previous workspace for ~2s. Repro: switch to org A -> click Dashboard -> switch to org B -> hit refresh twice. Screenshot attached.
kevin: ack. any logs? which route? console-list API?
sara: console-api/v1/dashboards?view=project but frontend uses cached 'workspace_bucket' header. I saw X-Org-Key: abc123 in prefetch call then later call missing header and response returned cached rows.
mike: hunch: prefetch KV cache tie keyed by workspace_id but our router uses workspace_bucket when routing. If bucket switch lags, the cache returns previous rows.
ops-bot: Deploy 2024-09-05 18:02 UTC - canary 12% finished
kevin: @sara can you dump trace id? any correlation id? maybe it's the rollout canary affinity.
sara: trace: 01-abcdef1234567890 snippet:
```http
GET /console-api/dashboards?view=project HTTP/1.1
Host: console.internal
X-Workspace-Bucket: wb-42
X-Trace-Id: trace-01
```
mia: quick fix idea: make the prefetch attach workspace header to cache key + add short TTL 500ms. longer fix: ensure routing policy waits for bucket assignment before responding.
kevin: agree. Telemetry alert: we saw spike of 0.08% cross-org rows during canary window. I'm adding an eval in rollout to check row-affinity metric.
ops-bot: Incident tracker created: INC-4421
sara: I'll throw up a patch to include workspace id in the cache key and add a canary guard. PR: #1234
mike: ping when deployed, I'll run repro and run long-run synthetic to confirm.
kevin: also add cheap unit test for header propagation and an integration test hitting prefetch edge. :thumbsup:
